question: When haloalkanes and aryl and vinyl halides react with magnesium metal they yield which reagent?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Grignard reagent.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• When haloalkanes and aryl and vinyl halides react with magnesium metal, they yield **Grignard reagents**.
 
• Grignard reagents are of the form **RMgX**, where R is an alkyl or aryl group and X is a halogen.
